name: reported-and-realized
title: Reported and realized error
idea: For a fixed report, its claimed wrong share and its expectation under an explicit reference law differ by at most the largest pair-error probability gap; a single fixed-truth realization can lie on either side.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 18 (reported and realized loss; a producer's model); builds on v1 G-05; a prior-SD control (from 1.6) sets the claim against realized shares at fixed true values, which is not the calibration identity of ch. 18; picture: a fixed report's claimed E/N under an assumed prior SD (the reader's control) beside its expected share under another law and the realized shares over replays of the simulated league
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 18.
caption: Simulated league of 30 units with deterministic true values and SEs .20, .10 and .05. Independent normal-normal teaching laws with prior mean 0; the reference prior SD is .15. Fixed-truth observation replays are not the conditional calibration identity.
